simp_chinese: 瓜霍博斯属于委内瑞拉平原广阔的阿普雷地域。阿拉瓦克和加勒比等原住民社群早于十七世纪的西班牙征服；十八世纪，大型牧场扩展，改变了这片内陆地域的聚落格局。

english: Guajoquilla belongs to the Chihuahua country around present-day Ciudad Jiménez. A Spanish presidio was founded here in 1753 under the name Santa Maria de las Caldas del Valle de Huejoquilla.
simp_chinese: 瓜霍基利亚属于今希门尼斯城周边的奇瓦瓦地区。西班牙人于1753年在这里建立军事据点，称为韦霍基利亚谷圣玛丽亚德拉斯卡尔达斯。

english: Gualamba lies in the Gran Chaco’s broader Mocoví landscape. Mocoví communities traditionally relied on hunting, fishing and gathering in country subject to flooding and difficult soils. Routes through the Chaco forest also point to exchange between these communities and neighbours beyond their immediate camps.
simp_chinese: 瓜兰巴位于大查科较广的莫科维地域。莫科维社群传统上在易受洪水影响、土壤条件艰难的土地上从事狩猎、捕鱼与采集。查科森林中的通路也表明，营地之外的社群之间存在交换联系。

english: Gualas belongs to the broader Mocovi country of the Gran Chaco. These Guaycuru communities followed mobile livelihoods based on fishing, hunting and gathering. Forest trade routes connected them with exchanges in skins, feathers and metal objects.
simp_chinese: 瓜拉斯属于大查科广义莫科维地区。这些瓜伊库鲁社群以捕鱼、狩猎与采集为基础流动生活。森林贸易道路使其参与兽皮、羽毛与金属器物的交换。

english: Gualeguas preserves the name of the Gualegua people, the early inhabitants of this part of northeastern Nuevo León. The settlement was recognized as the village of St. Nicholas of Gualeguas in 1821. Its surrounding municipality lies only about 180 metres above sea level.
simp_chinese: 瓜莱瓜斯之名保留了这一带早期居民瓜莱瓜人的名称，地点位于新莱昂东北部。1821年，当地获承认为圣尼古拉斯-德瓜莱瓜斯村。周围市镇海拔仅约180米。

english: Gualeguay belongs to a major river basin of Entre Ríos. The river meanders south-southwest through the province’s central lowlands before entering a Paraná distributary in the delta, gathering streams between the Montiel and Cuchilla Grande hills.
simp_chinese: 瓜莱瓜伊位于恩特雷里奥斯的重要河流流域。河道穿过省域中部低地，向西南偏南蜿蜒流淌，汇集蒙铁尔与大丘陵之间的溪流，最终在三角洲注入巴拉那河的一条汊道。

english: Guama lies in the Puerto Rican landscape of Guayama, where Guamaní is recorded as a rural barrio. Spanish gazetteers listed the community before the island passed to the United States in 1898; the following year its population was counted at 1,360.
simp_chinese: 瓜马位于波多黎各瓜亚马一带，瓜马尼在当地被记载为乡村区。1898年岛屿转归美国之前，西班牙地名志已收录这一社群；次年的人口普查记录当地有1360人。

english: Guamanmayo belongs to the northern Peruvian coastal country of Chimor. The wider region’s capital, Chan Chan, depended on irrigation fed by rivers descending from the Andes through an otherwise arid coastal desert.
simp_chinese: 瓜曼马约属于秘鲁北部沿海的奇莫尔地区。地区都城昌昌依赖发源于安第斯山的河流灌溉，周围则是干旱的沿海沙漠。

english: Guamblin's rocky coast and heavy seas made landing difficult, though Chono canoe travellers visited the island before Europeans named it Nuestra Señora del Socorro in 1557–1558. In 1725 the leaking Dutch ship Don Louis anchored here after a disastrous passage around Cape Horn. Crewmen gathered fresh water and wild celery for the sick. A storm then tore the ship from its anchorage, leaving three men ashore; when a boat finally returned months later, only their remains were found. The episode gives this forested island a stark place in the history of desperate provisioning on the Patagonian coast.
simp_chinese: 瓜姆布林岛岩岸与巨浪使登陆艰难，不过在欧洲人于1557至1558年将其命名为救助圣母岛之前，乔诺独木舟行旅者便已到访。1725年，漏水的荷兰“唐路易斯”号艰难绕过合恩角后在此抛锚。船员采集淡水与野芹菜，救助患病同伴。风暴随后将船从锚地吹走，三人被留在岸上；数月后小艇终于返回，只找到遗骸。此事使这座森林岛屿，在巴塔哥尼亚海岸绝境补给史中留下严酷一页。

english: Guamonial belongs to the wider Gorontalo region of Sulawesi. This region occupies part of the Minahasa Peninsula, facing the Sulawesi Sea to the north and the Gulf of Tomini to the south.
simp_chinese: 瓜莫尼亚尔属于苏拉威西的哥伦打洛地区。该地区占据米纳哈萨半岛的一部分，北临苏拉威西海，南面托米尼湾。

english: Guamontey belongs to the wider Caracas country of northern Venezuela. The regional valley follows the Guaire River, separated from the Caribbean shore by the steep Cerro El Ávila range. Indigenous communities occupied this valley before the Spanish city of Caracas was founded in 1567.
simp_chinese: 瓜蒙特属于委内瑞拉北部的广义加拉加斯地区。地区河谷沿瓜伊雷河展开，陡峻的阿维拉山将其与加勒比海岸分开。1567年西班牙加拉加斯城建立之前，原住民社群已居住在河谷中。

english: Guamuhaya belongs to Cuba, the Caribbean island at the meeting of the Caribbean Sea, Gulf of Mexico and Atlantic. The wider island was settled around six thousand years ago, and Guanahatabey and Taino peoples were present when Spanish colonization began.
simp_chinese: 瓜穆哈亚属于古巴，这座加勒比岛屿位于加勒比海、墨西哥湾与大西洋交汇处。全岛约六千年前已有居民，西班牙殖民开始时生活着瓜纳哈塔贝和泰诺等族群。

english: Gu’an belongs to the country south of Beijing. The wider regional capital received the name Beijing, meaning Northern Capital, in 1403 under the Yongle emperor, reflecting the growing importance of the northern imperial centre.
simp_chinese: 固安属于北京以南地区。更广阔区域的都城于永乐时期1403年获得意为北方都城的北京之名，反映北方帝国中心日益重要的地位。

english: Guana belongs to the multilingual Indigenous country of the Paraguayan Chaco. The name Guaná has been used for several languages, including Kaskihá or Cashquiha. Kaskihá belongs to the Mascoian linguistic world of the Chaco.
simp_chinese: 瓜纳属于巴拉圭查科多语言原住民地域。瓜纳一名曾用于多种语言，包括卡斯基哈语。卡斯基哈语属于查科的马斯科伊语言世界。

english: Guanabara opens between conspicuous headlands, including Sugar Loaf, into a broad bay dotted with islands. Tamoio and Tupiniquim communities inhabited its shores when Portuguese voyagers arrived in 1502. French settlers later attempted to establish France Antarctique, building Fort Coligny on an island before Portuguese expeditions expelled them. Fortifications subsequently guarded the entrances with overlapping fields of fire. The familiar name Rio de Janeiro need not imply that early sailors mistook the bay for a river: contemporary Portuguese usage could apply 'rio' more widely to coastal waters.
simp_chinese: 瓜纳巴拉湾从包括糖面包山在内的醒目岬角之间展开，内部水面宽广，岛屿星罗棋布。葡萄牙航海者于1502年抵达时，塔莫约与图皮尼金社群已居住在岸边。法国移民后来试图建立南极法兰西，在岛上修筑科利尼堡，最终被葡萄牙远征逐出。此后多座堡垒以交叉火力守护入口。人们熟悉的里约热内卢之名，未必意味着早期水手把海湾误认成河流；当时葡萄牙语的rio也可更广泛指称沿海水域。

english: Guanabo belongs to the Jaragua country of Hispaniola. This great Antillean island lies between Cuba and Puerto Rico and was inhabited by Taíno and other Indigenous peoples when Columbus arrived. The wider island later became the setting for the earliest Spanish settlements in the Americas.
simp_chinese: 瓜纳沃属于伊斯帕尼奥拉的哈拉瓜地区。这座安的列斯大岛位于古巴与波多黎各之间，哥伦布到来时居住着泰诺及其他原住民。更广阔的岛屿后来成为美洲最早一批西班牙聚落的所在地。

english: Guanaceví lies in the high country of northwestern Durango, at roughly 2,100 metres above sea level. Gold and silver occur among the mineral riches of its mining district. Its upland climate has cool winters and a pronounced summer rainy season, a sharp seasonal rhythm in this part of northern Mexico. The town also preserves a varied food tradition, including sopes, stuffed peppers and tezhuino, linking the mining settlement to the everyday culture of its surrounding countryside.
simp_chinese: 瓜纳塞维坐落在杜兰戈西北部高地，海拔约2100米。周边矿区蕴藏着黄金、白银等矿产。这里冬季凉冷，夏季雨季明显，鲜明的季节变化构成墨西哥北部这片高地的生活节律。镇上还保留着多样的饮食传统，包括索佩饼、酿辣椒和特苏伊诺饮品，使这处矿业聚落与周边乡间的日常文化相连。

english: Guanahani was the Lucayan name of the Bahamian island reached by Columbus on 12 October 1492 and renamed San Salvador. Its exact identification remains disputed: the traditional association with Watlings Island is only one of several proposed locations. Columbus's letter spread the name across Europe, while later knowledge of his movements depended heavily on Las Casas's abstract of the voyage journal. The uncertainty is part of the island's history, reminding the reader that a famous landing can be more securely dated than precisely placed on a modern map.
simp_chinese: 瓜纳哈尼是哥伦布于1492年10月12日抵达、随后改称圣萨尔瓦多的巴哈马岛屿的卢卡约语名称。其确切位置仍有争论，传统上对应沃特林岛的说法只是数种候选之一。哥伦布的书信将名称传遍欧洲，后人对航程的了解则很大程度依赖拉斯卡萨斯对航海日记的摘录。不确定性本身就是岛屿历史的一部分，提醒人们：一场著名登陆的日期，可能比它在现代地图上的具体位置更加确凿。

english: Guanahacabibes forms the western extremity of Cuba, ending at Cape San Antonio. Its surrounding waters support lobster and snapper fisheries, while white-sand plains and numerous lakes distinguish the protected peninsula.
simp_chinese: 瓜纳马卡比贝斯构成古巴西端，止于圣安东尼奥角。周围水域支持龙虾和鲷鱼渔业，白沙平原与众多湖泊则是这片受保护半岛的特色。

english: Guanambi lies in Bahia's interior, roughly eight hundred kilometres southwest of Salvador, on land about 525 metres above sea level. The municipality was founded in 1919, well after the early modern period; its later urban identity should therefore be distinguished from the older landscape represented here. Known as the ‘City of Cotton’, it became a commercial centre of inland Bahia. Its distance from the coast places it within the broad hinterland rather than among the Atlantic ports that first connected Bahia to overseas trade.
simp_chinese: 瓜南比位于巴伊亚内陆，在萨尔瓦多西南约八百公里处，海拔约525米。该市镇建立于1919年，远晚于近代早期，因此其后来的城市身份应与这片土地更早的面貌加以区分。瓜南比有“棉花之城”的别称，后来成为巴伊亚内陆的商业中心。它远离海岸，属于广大的腹地，与最初把巴伊亚接入海外贸易的那些大西洋港口有着不同的地理位置。

english: Guanare stands near the Andean foothills on the edge of Venezuela’s southwestern floodplains. The Portuguese captain João Fernandes de Leão Pacheco founded the town in 1591, placing a colonial settlement within country suited to farming and livestock. It also became associated with the tradition of the Virgin of Coromoto appearing to an Indigenous inhabitant. The town’s position joins the low plains to the mountain margin, while foundation and religious memory give that geographical meeting a distinct human history.
simp_chinese: 瓜纳雷位于安第斯山麓附近、委内瑞拉西南洪泛平原边缘。葡萄牙船长若昂·费尔南德斯·德莱昂·帕切科于1591年建镇，使殖民聚落进入适宜农业与畜牧的地区。此地也与科罗莫托圣母向一位原住民显现的传统相联系。城镇位置连接低平原与山地边缘，建镇和宗教记忆则为这一地理交会赋予独特的人类历史。

english: Guanay stands on the Tipuani River in Bolivia’s Yungas. It lies at the end of the Gold Digger’s Trail from Sorata, with local mining and boat routes connecting its river country to the Beni basin.
simp_chinese: 瓜纳伊坐落在玻利维亚永加斯的蒂普阿尼河畔。这里位于从索拉塔出发的淘金者道路终点，当地采矿与舟运将河流地区接入贝尼河流域。

english: Guancavilca belongs to the late pre-Columbian cultural world of coastal Ecuador. The broader Manteño-Huancavilca culture flourished roughly from the ninth to sixteenth centuries and included several related coastal groups.
simp_chinese: 万卡维尔卡属于厄瓜多尔沿海晚期前哥伦布文化世界。广义曼特尼奥—万卡维尔卡文化约于九至十六世纪繁荣，包括多个相关沿海族群。

english: Guancheng belongs to Shandong, a region long important to Chinese religious and intellectual life. Mount Tai became a major sacred mountain, while Qufu, the birthplace of Confucius, developed into a center of the Confucian tradition.
simp_chinese: 冠城属于山东，这片地区长期在中国宗教和思想生活中具有重要地位。泰山成为重要圣山，而孔子故里曲阜则发展为儒家传统的中心。

english: Guancheng belongs to the Zhengzhou country on the southern bank of the Yellow River. The wider urban area contains an early Shang centre and stands where the river valley opens onto the North China Plain.
simp_chinese: 管城处于黄河南岸的郑州地区。更大的城市区域包含商代早期都邑，位于黄河河谷展开为华北平原之处。

english: Guanchenis belongs to the wider Guachichil world of northern central Mexico. Guachichil territories stretched across Zacatecas and neighbouring regions toward Saltillo; their position beside Spanish mining routes enabled effective resistance and raiding during the Chichimeca Wars.
simp_chinese: 瓜恩切尼斯属于墨西哥中北部广义的瓜奇奇尔人世界。瓜奇奇尔人的领地横跨萨卡特卡斯及邻近地区，并延向萨尔蒂约；靠近西班牙矿区与交通线的位置，使他们在奇奇梅克战争中能够有效抵抗与袭击。

english: Guandacol is a village in northwestern Argentina. It forms a municipality in the La Rioja region.
simp_chinese: 瓜安达科尔是阿根廷西北部的一座村庄。它在拉里奥哈地区构成一处市镇。

english: Guanfu belongs to the Dongguan country of the Pearl River Delta. The broader region lies between Guangzhou, Huizhou and Shenzhen, and traces of human habitation there extend back about five thousand years.
simp_chinese: 官富属于珠江三角洲的东莞地区。广义地区处于广州、惠州与深圳之间，当地人类活动痕迹可追溯至约五千年前。

english: Guang'an belongs to the Jingzhou country of eastern Gansu. In the wider region, the ancient city near present-day Jingchuan was begun under the Western Han and abandoned in the early Ming, with portions still preserved.
simp_chinese: 广安属于甘肃东部的泾州地区。在这一带，今泾川附近的古城始建于西汉，明初废弃，部分遗迹仍然保存。

english: Guangchang lies near the Fujian-Jiangxi watershed and contains the headwaters of the Fu River. Established as a county in 1138 under the Southern Song, it became known for white lotus cultivation, a lasting feature of the district’s identity.
simp_chinese: 广昌位于闽赣分水岭附近，抚河发源于县境。南宋绍兴八年即1138年置县，后来以白莲种植著称，成为当地长期延续的特色。

english: Guangde occupies the eastern edge of Anhui, adjoining Jiangsu and Zhejiang. It is administered by Xuancheng, with its government seat at Taozhou.
simp_chinese: 广德位于安徽东缘，与江苏、浙江接壤。这里由宣城管辖，治所设在桃州。

english: Guanghai is a coastal-region town in Guangdong. It belongs to Taishan within Jiangmen, and its name appeared as Quanghai on an eighteenth-century map of the Pearl River Delta region.
simp_chinese: 广海是广东沿海地区的一座城镇。它隶属江门台山，十八世纪珠江三角洲地区地图上曾以Quanghai标注其名。

english: The waters off Guanghai form part of the northern South China Sea. This western Pacific basin links China's southern coast with Indochina and the island passages towards the Philippines and Indonesia.
simp_chinese: 广海附近水域属于南海北部。这片西太平洋海盆将中国南岸同中南半岛，以及通向菲律宾、印度尼西亚的岛间航道连接起来。

english: Guanghua belongs to the Xiangyang country of northwestern Hubei. The wider region is shaped by the Han River, whose opposite banks held the historic cities of Xiangyang and Fancheng.
simp_chinese: 光化属于湖北西北襄阳地区。广义地区受汉江塑造，河流两岸分别坐落着历史城市襄阳与樊城。

english: Guangji belongs to the Huangzhou country of Hubei. In the wider region, communities associated with the ancient state of Huang settled after Chu conquered their kingdom in 648 BC, leaving a legacy in numerous local place names.
simp_chinese: 广济属于湖北黄州地区。在更广阔的区域，楚国于公元前648年征服黄国后，与古黄国相关的人群迁居此地，其影响保留于众多地方名称。

english: Guangling belongs to the Datong country of northern Shanxi. The wider region stood on the frontier between Chinese agricultural lands and the steppe and was long known for horse trade.
simp_chinese: 广灵属于山西北部的大同地区。更广区域处于中国农耕土地与草原之间的边疆，长期以马匹贸易著称。

english: Guangnan lies in southeastern Yunnan near the Guangxi border. Its seat at present-day Liancheng was the heart of the Gouding kingdom, which lasted from the late second century before the common era into the early fourth century.
simp_chinese: 广南位于云南东南部、广西边界附近。今日莲城一带的县治曾是句町国中心，该国从公元前二世纪末延续至公元四世纪初。

english: Guangning, now Beizhen, lies in west-central Liaoning. Established as Guangning County under the Jin in 1123, it became a Ming military base and prosperous centre of frontier trade in the Liaodong region.
simp_chinese: 广宁今称北镇，位于辽宁中西部。金朝于1123年置广宁县，明代这里发展为辽东地区军事基地与繁荣的边境贸易中心。

english: Guangning lies along the Sui River valley in western Guangdong. The county was founded in 1559 under the Ming Jiajing emperor and is known for its extensive bamboo resources.
simp_chinese: 广宁位于广东西部的绥江河谷。该县设立于明嘉靖年间的1559年，并以丰富的竹类资源闻名。

english: Guangping lies in southern Hebei. It is a county of the Handan region, covering a compact territory of roughly 320 square kilometres.
simp_chinese: 广平位于河北南部。它是邯郸地区的一个县，辖境约三百二十平方公里。

english: Guangshan lies in southeastern Henan in the Xinyang region. The historian and statesman Sima Guang was born here in 1019.
simp_chinese: 光山位于河南东南部的信阳地区。历史学家、政治家司马光于1019年出生于此。

english: Guangsuoling belongs to the Anshun region of southwestern Guizhou. In the Warring States era, the wider area belonged to Yelang, an independent kingdom associated with the Beipan and Nanpan rivers.
simp_chinese: 广顺岭属于贵州西南部的安顺地区。战国时期，更广阔的地域属于独立的夜郎国，其活动范围与北盘江和南盘江相联系。

english: Guangxi belongs to Yunnan’s southeastern highland country. The wider province is mountainous, descending from the northwest toward the southeast, with deep river valleys and exceptional plant diversity. Ancient settlements around Lake Dian later formed a core of the Dian kingdom.
simp_chinese: 广西属于云南东南部高地地区。广阔省域多山，地势从西北向东南降低，拥有深切河谷与格外丰富的植物多样性。滇池周围的古代聚落后来形成滇国的核心。

english: Guangze lies in northwestern Fujian on the Jiangxi border. The county was administered as part of Jiangxi during the Republican period, reflecting its position between the two provincial regions.
simp_chinese: 光泽位于福建西北部、江西边界一带。民国时期曾归江西管辖，体现出它处于两省地域之间的位置。

english: Guangzhou stands on the Pearl River, where southern China opens toward the trading waters of Asia. Earlier Panyu served as the capital of Zhao Tuo's Nanyue kingdom before Han conquest in 111 BC. Foreign goods found in its tombs reveal connections reaching well beyond China. The later port attracted merchants and travelers from across the Indian Ocean; fourteenth-century visitors described its crafts and shipyards. Ming maritime prohibitions restricted this commerce without erasing its geographic advantages. The city's history turns repeatedly on the tension between an outward-looking harbor and governments determined to regulate access to it.
simp_chinese: 广州坐落于珠江之滨，是中国南方面向亚洲贸易海域的门户。前身番禺曾为赵佗南越国都城，直至公元前111年被汉朝征服。墓葬中的舶来物品，显示其联系远超中国境内。后来的港口吸引横越印度洋的商旅，十四世纪访客记述了这里的工艺与船场。明代海禁限制贸易，却未抹去地理优势。城市历史反复围绕着面向海外的港湾与力图管理对外通道的朝廷之间的张力展开。

english: Guangzong is a county in southern Hebei, within the Xingtai region. Its countryside includes the townships of Dapingtai, Dongzhao and Hetaoyuan around Guangzong town.
simp_chinese: 广宗是河北南部邢台地区的县。广宗镇周围的乡村包括大平台、东召和核桃园等乡。

english: Guaniguanico forms the mountainous spine of western Cuba, running from the country near Guane toward Mariel. The San Diego River divides its two principal sections, the Sierra de los Órganos in the west and Sierra del Rosario to the east. Pan de Guajaibón rises highest above the surrounding land, though the range is modest beside the great continental mountains. Valleys, wooded slopes and falls produce sharp local contrasts within its length. The name has been linked by scholars to a possible Guanahatabey inheritance, but that interpretation remains a proposal. The range's lasting identity is geographical: it organizes western Cuba into adjoining hill countries and valleys rather than one uniform plain.
simp_chinese: 瓜尼瓜尼科构成古巴西部的山地骨架，从瓜内附近延向马里埃尔。圣迭戈河分开两大部分：西侧风琴山脉与东侧罗萨里奥山脉。瓜哈伊蓬峰最高，虽同大陆巨山相比整体高度并不惊人。谷地、林坡与瀑布，使山系内部产生鲜明局部差异。有学者将名称联系到可能的瓜纳哈塔贝语遗产，但这种解释仍属提议。山系持久的身份在地理本身：它将古巴西部组织为相邻丘陵与河谷，而非一片均匀平原。

english: Guanima is the Lucayan name of Cat Island in the Bahamas, meaning middle waters land. The island contains Mount Alvernia, the highest point in the Bahamian archipelago.
simp_chinese: 瓜尼马是巴哈马猫岛的卢卡亚语名称，意为中间水域之地。岛上有巴哈马群岛最高点阿尔弗尼亚山。

english: Guanimar stands on the southern coast of western Cuba, in present-day Artemisa. Its exposed coastal position has repeatedly brought hurricane damage, including storms in 1898 and severe flooding in 2023.
simp_chinese: 瓜尼马尔位于古巴西部南海岸，现属阿尔特米萨。暴露的沿海位置使其多次遭受飓风破坏，包括1898年的风暴以及2023年的严重洪水。

english: Guanipa belongs to the river country of northeastern Venezuela. The Guanipa River flows through this region to the Gulf of Paria.
simp_chinese: 瓜尼帕属于委内瑞拉东北部的河流地区。瓜尼帕河流经这一地区，注入帕里亚湾。

english: Guantánamo's inland settlement belongs to the country behind one of Cuba's finest natural harbors. The city itself was founded in 1797, and should be distinguished from the older bay and its shores. Sugarcane and cotton formed traditional parts of the local economy, with maritime access through Caimanera. Much later, the bay's strategic position brought foreign naval power and a very different international reputation. The history of the town begins on a smaller scale, in the relationship between agricultural land, a nearby port and the sheltered waters of eastern Cuba.
simp_chinese: 关塔那摩的内陆聚落位于古巴优良天然港湾后方。城市本身建于1797年，应与更古老的海湾及岸地历史区分。甘蔗与棉花是传统经济组成部分，海上联系通过凯马内拉港维系。远在后来，海湾战略位置带来外国海军力量，以及截然不同的国际声名。城镇的历史起于更小尺度，围绕农田、邻近港口与古巴东部避风水域之间的关系展开。

english: Guantánamo preserves a Taíno name for the sheltered waters of southeastern Cuba. Columbus arrived in 1494 and called the harbour Puerto Grande, encountering fishermen preparing food for a local chief. Under Spanish rule it became an important southern harbour. A British expedition occupied the bay in 1741 and renamed it Cumberland Bay, intending to advance on Santiago, but resistance forced a withdrawal. Its later fame can obscure this older history, in which a fine anchorage repeatedly attracted fleets seeking a foothold on Cuba.
simp_chinese: 关塔那摩保存着泰诺人对古巴东南部避风水域的称呼。哥伦布于1494年来到这里，将港湾称为大港，遇见正在为地方首领准备食物的渔民。西班牙统治下，它成为南岸重要港口。1741年英国远征军占据海湾并改称坎伯兰湾，计划进攻圣地亚哥，却因抵抗而撤退。后来广为人知的历史容易遮蔽更早的篇章：优良锚地反复吸引试图在古巴取得据点的舰队。

english: Guantao lies in southern Hebei beside Shandong. Across the Wei Canal to the east lie Guan County and Linqing.
simp_chinese: 馆陶位于河北南部，毗邻山东。东侧隔卫运河与冠县、临清相望。

english: Guanyang lies in northeastern Guangxi and borders Hunan to the east. The county belongs to the Guilin administrative region.
simp_chinese: 灌阳位于广西东北部，东邻湖南。该县属于桂林行政区域。

english: The Guan region is associated with the Dujiangyan irrigation works on the Min River. Built under Qin rule in the third century BCE, the system divided water to irrigate the Chengdu country.
simp_chinese: 灌地与岷江上的都江堰水利工程相联系。该系统建于公元前三世纪秦国统治时期，通过分水灌溉成都地区。

english: Guaquili belongs to the wider Joara country of the Blue Ridge foothills. Joara was a Mississippian regional chiefdom with an earthen platform mound. In 1567 Juan Pardo established Fort San Juan there, creating a short-lived Spanish outpost far inland from the Atlantic coast.
simp_chinese: 瓜基利属于蓝岭山麓的乔阿拉地区。乔阿拉是密西西比文化的区域酋邦，拥有土筑台基。1567年胡安·帕尔多在此建立圣胡安堡，形成一处远离大西洋海岸、存在短暂的西班牙内陆据点。

english: Guaquire belongs to the Caracas country of northern Venezuela. Its wider setting faces the Caribbean, within a northern South American region whose mainland meets the Caribbean Sea and Atlantic Ocean and includes numerous offshore islands.
simp_chinese: 瓜基雷属于委内瑞拉北部加拉加斯地区。其大区域面向加勒比海，这片南美洲北方土地濒临加勒比海与大西洋，并包括众多近海岛屿。

english: Guaraca belongs to the broader island world of Boriken, now Puerto Rico. Successive Indigenous cultures settled the island before the Spanish arrival, including the Ortoiroid, Saladoid and Taíno.
simp_chinese: 瓜拉卡属于博里肯、即今日波多黎各更广阔的岛屿区域。在西班牙人到来之前，奥托伊罗德、萨拉多伊德和泰诺等原住民文化先后在岛上定居。

english: Guarapiri belongs to the wider Goitacá country on eastern Brazil's coast. Unlike neighbouring Tupi-speaking peoples, the Goitacá were classed as Tapuia; in the sixteenth century their lands extended between the São Mateus and Paraíba do Sul rivers, spanning parts of today's Espírito Santo and Rio de Janeiro.
simp_chinese: 瓜拉皮里属于巴西东岸广义的戈伊塔卡人地区。与邻近使用图皮语的人群不同，戈伊塔卡人被归为塔普亚；十六世纪，其土地延伸于圣马特乌斯河与南帕拉伊巴河之间，横跨今圣埃斯皮里图与里约热内卢部分地区。

english: Guarapuava's plateau lies in the interior of Paraná, where Portuguese expansion reached an already named landscape in the later eighteenth century. The town developed in the early nineteenth century, with colonization around the Coutinho and Jordão rivers and the parish of Our Lady of Bethlehem. Tropeiro families, associated with overland driving and transport, formed part of its first settler community. Official instructions shaped the arrangement of the new village, with church and streets serving as signs of organized colonial occupation. The name itself preserves an Indigenous linguistic inheritance, commonly explained through the sound of the maned wolf. Settlement planning and transport consequently overlaid, rather than created, the identity of this southern upland country.
simp_chinese: 瓜拉普阿瓦高原位于巴拉那内陆，十八世纪后期葡萄牙扩张抵达的是一片早已有名称的景观。城镇于十九世纪初发展，殖居围绕科廷纽河、若尔当河与伯利恒圣母教区展开。同陆上赶畜和运输有关的特罗佩罗家庭，是最初移民社群的一部分。官方指令塑造新村布局，教堂与街道成为有组织殖民占据的标志。名称本身则保存原住民语言遗产，通常被解释为与鬃狼发出的声音相关。因此，定居规划与运输是在这片南部高地既有身份之上叠加，而非从无到有创造它。

english: Guarasugwa belongs to the upper Guaporé country of western Brazil. Across the wider basin, waters connect to the Madeira and ultimately the Amazon. The Guaporé and the Paraguay both rise in the Parecis plateau region, helping explain links between their otherwise separate fish faunas.
simp_chinese: 瓜拉苏瓜属于巴西西部上瓜波雷河地区。在更广阔流域内，河水通向马德拉河，最终汇入亚马孙河。瓜波雷河与巴拉圭河均起源于帕雷西斯高原地区，有助于解释两条独立水系之间的鱼类联系。

english: Guarasugwe belongs to the wider Guaporé river country between Brazil and Bolivia. The Guaporé crosses the Beni savannas and feeds the Madeira–Amazon system. Its fish fauna shares connections with the Paraguay basin, whose headwaters also rise on Brazil's Parecis Plateau.
simp_chinese: 瓜拉苏圭属于巴西与玻利维亚之间更广阔的瓜波雷河地区。瓜波雷河穿过贝尼稀树草原，汇入马德拉—亚马逊水系。其鱼类群与巴拉圭河流域也有联系，两者源头均位于巴西帕雷西斯高原。

english: Guarasugwe Forest belongs to the Guapore river landscape between western Brazil and northeastern Bolivia. The wider river forms a long international boundary and drains through the Madeira toward the Amazon. Its basin contains a rich fish fauna, with some connections to the Paraguay system across the Parecis watershed.
simp_chinese: 瓜拉苏圭森林属于巴西西部与玻利维亚东北部之间的瓜波雷河地域。整条河构成长段国界，并经马代拉河水系流向亚马孙河。流域鱼类丰富，部分种类通过帕雷西斯分水岭两侧的联系，与巴拉圭河水系相通。

english: Guaratinguetá takes its identity from the Paraíba do Sul valley, whose riverside herons were familiar to the region's indigenous inhabitants. Portuguese settlement followed rumours of mineral wealth in the Mantiqueira mountains; a chapel was begun in 1630, and a formal village followed in 1651. During the eighteenth century it supplied travellers and miners moving towards Minas Gerais. Narrow streets filled on holy days and festivals as commerce grew. The settlement's fortunes thus depended less on possessing the gold itself than on feeding and serving those who sought it inland.
simp_chinese: 瓜拉廷格塔的身份扎根于南帕拉伊巴河谷，河畔白鹭早为当地原住民所熟知。葡萄牙移民追随曼蒂凯拉山矿藏传闻来到这里，1630年开始建造礼拜堂，1651年又正式设村。18世纪，聚落为前往米纳斯吉拉斯的旅人和矿工提供补给。随着商业成长，狭窄街道在圣日与节庆挤满人群。它的命运因而更依靠供养和服务深入内陆的寻金者。

english: Guarau Island belongs to the coastal waters around Guaratuba in southern Brazil. On the neighbouring Paraná coast, the Portuguese crown promoted settlement against foreign incursions, and the town of Guaratuba was founded in 1765.
simp_chinese: 瓜劳岛属于巴西南部瓜拉图巴周边的沿海水域。在邻近的巴拉那海岸，葡萄牙王室为抵御外国袭扰而推动殖民定居，瓜拉图巴城镇于1765年建立。

english: The Guarayo country lies in the forests of eastern Bolivia, north of Santa Cruz. Its people speak a language of the Tupian family, and their ancestral connections are commonly traced toward the Guaraní. Agriculture binds much of community life to the land. Traditional accounts of creation honor Alaangui, Mbirachucha and Candir, while Zaguaguayu is remembered as a first ancestor. Such stories and the making of bark-cloth clothing give this wooded country a cultural history alongside the fields that sustain it, rather than leaving the forest as an empty space between larger states.
simp_chinese: 瓜拉约人的土地位于玻利维亚东部、圣克鲁斯以北的森林中。他们使用图皮语系语言，祖源通常被追溯至瓜拉尼人。农业使社群生活的许多部分同土地紧密相连。传统创世叙述尊奉阿兰吉、姆比拉丘查与坎迪尔，并把扎瓜瓜尤视为始祖。这些故事与树皮布衣的制作，使林地拥有与农田并行的文化历史，森林并非大国之间的空白。

english: Guarda was founded in 1199 in the uplands of north-central Portugal. The city became the capital of its surrounding district; its wider municipality covers more than seven hundred square kilometres, giving the urban centre an extensive rural hinterland.
simp_chinese: 瓜达于1199年建立，位于葡萄牙中北部高地。城市后来成为周边瓜达区的首府；其市镇范围超过七百平方公里，城镇中心之外还有广阔乡村腹地。

english: Guardafui Channel opens between the tip of the Horn of Africa and the islands toward Socotra. In its narrower sense it lies between the Somali headland and Abd al Kuri, joining the Gulf of Aden with the wider Indian Ocean. Deep water and exposed approaches give it a different character from a sheltered coastal harbor. Cyclones can arrive from the southeast, and the scattered islands have sometimes provided refuge for stranded sailors. Named for Cape Guardafui, the passage is a geographic hinge where ships round Africa’s northeastern extremity and choose between the seas to north and south.
simp_chinese: 瓜尔达富伊海峡展开在非洲之角尖端与通向索科特拉的岛屿之间。狭义上，它位于索马里海岬与阿卜杜库里岛之间，把亚丁湾联入更广印度洋。深水与无遮蔽入口，使它有别于受庇护沿海港湾。气旋能从东南抵达，零散岛屿有时也为遇险水手提供避难处。海峡以瓜尔达富伊角命名，是船只绕过非洲东北尽头、选择向北或向南海域的地理枢纽。

english:
Guárico opens from the rocky hills of Venezuela's coastal ranges into the broad grasslands of the central Llanos. The river that gives the region its name runs through a landscape of isolated morros and extensive plains. Before Spanish settlement, Tamanacos, Palenques, Cumanagotos, Guamos and Otomacos inhabited these lands; colonial expansion gathered pace only in the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries.

The plains became a chain of mission towns and settlements, including Altagracia de Orituco, Calabozo and Tucupido. Humboldt and Bonpland crossed the region in March 1800 on their journey towards the Orinoco. During the independence wars, its open country became a battlefield: José Antonio Páez defeated royalist forces at Calabozo in 1818. The later province, created in 1848, inherited a landscape closely associated with cattle raising and Llanero culture.
simp_chinese:
瓜里科从委内瑞拉海岸山地的岩丘延伸至中部利亚诺斯的辽阔草原。赋予当地名称的瓜里科河流经孤立岩峰与大片平原交错的土地。西班牙人定居以前，塔马纳科人、帕伦克人、库马纳戈托人、瓜莫人和奥托马科人生活于此；殖民扩张直到十七、十八世纪才加快。

平原上逐渐出现一系列传教聚落和城镇，包括奥里图科的阿尔塔格拉西亚、卡拉沃索与图库皮多。1800年3月，洪堡与邦普兰在前往奥里诺科河的旅途中穿过这一地区。独立战争时期，这片开阔土地成为战场：1818年，何塞·安东尼奥·派斯在卡拉沃索击败保王军。1848年设立的瓜里科省，继承了这片与牧牛业和利亚内罗文化紧密相连的土地。

english: Guarinoes lies in the wider river country around Honda, where the Guarinó and Gualí meet the Magdalena valley. The indigenous Ondaimas inhabited the Magdalena’s banks in this region. Rivers shaped its later development as well: Honda became an important port linking the Caribbean coast with the inland route toward Bogotá.
simp_chinese: 瓜里诺斯位于翁达周边的广大河谷，瓜里诺河、瓜利河与马格达莱纳河谷在此相连。翁代马原住民曾生活在这一地区的马格达莱纳河岸。河道也塑造了后来的交通格局：翁达发展成重要河港，连接加勒比海岸与通向波哥大的内陆道路。

english: Guarisamey belongs to the Durango setting of northwestern Mexico. The wider region lies where the Central Mexican Plateau meets the Sierra Madre Occidental, with high mountain country rising above the valleys.
simp_chinese: 瓜里萨梅属于墨西哥西北部的杜兰戈地区。广义地区位于墨西哥中央高原与西马德雷山脉交汇处，高山耸立于谷地上方。

english: Guaritico belongs to the Apure plains of Venezuela. The wider territory was inhabited by Arawak, Carib and other Indigenous peoples before colonial expansion, and large cattle estates developed there from the early eighteenth century.
simp_chinese: 瓜里蒂科属于委内瑞拉的阿普雷平原。殖民扩张之前，整个地区有阿拉瓦克、加勒比等原住民族居住，18世纪初开始发展大型牧牛庄园。

english: Guarungube belongs to the Mayaimi country around Florida’s Lake Okeechobee. The wider people built ceremonial and village earthwork mounds and dug canals for canoes; their name, like the later lake name in another language, evokes “big water.”
simp_chinese: 瓜伦古贝属于佛罗里达奥基乔比湖周围的马亚伊米地区。更广阔的族群修建祭祀与村落土丘，并开凿供独木舟通行的运河；族名与后来另一语言中的湖名一样，都有“大水”之意。

english: Guarzo belongs to the Nechí River region of northwestern Colombia. The river rises around Yarumal and flows into the Cauca, crossing a country known for substantial gold deposits; its name is explained through Yamesí words for gold and river.
simp_chinese: 瓜尔索属于哥伦比亚西北部内奇河地区。内奇河发源于亚鲁马尔一带并汇入考卡河，流经以丰富金矿著称的土地；其名称被解释为来自亚梅西语的黄金与河流两词。

english: Guastalla lies on the Po between the worlds of Parma, Mantua and Reggio. In the Middle Ages its rich agricultural estate also served as a toll point for goods moving along the river. The Torelli governed from 1406 until the Gonzaga took over in 1539, turning it into a princely residence associated with writers and artists. It became a separate duchy in 1621 before passing into the Parmesan state in 1748. Farming, river revenue and courtly patronage gave this small centre an importance disproportionate to its size.
simp_chinese: 瓜斯塔拉位于波河畔，处在帕尔马、曼托瓦与雷焦诸地之间。中世纪富裕的农业庄园，同时也是沿河货物的收费点。托雷利家族自1406年统治，直到1539年贡扎加接管，使其成为与作家艺术家相联系的诸侯驻地。1621年，它成为独立公国，1748年又并入帕尔马国家。农业、河流税收与宫廷赞助，使这座小中心拥有超出规模的重要性。

english: Guatacuba belongs to the upper Tocantins country of central Brazil. The wider river rises in the Pireneus uplands and runs north through the interior, its name deriving from Tupi words meaning toucan's beak.
simp_chinese: 瓜塔库巴属于巴西中部的托坎廷斯河上游地区。更广阔的河流发源于皮雷内乌斯高地，向北穿过内陆，其名称源于图皮语中意为巨嘴鸟之喙的词语。

english: Guato belongs to the wider Cuiabá country of Mato Grosso. Cuiabá lies near the geographical centre of South America and developed during an eighteenth-century gold rush.
simp_chinese: 瓜托属于马托格罗索更广阔的库亚巴地区。库亚巴位于南美洲地理中心附近，在十八世纪淘金热期间发展起来。

english: Guaviare belongs to the lowland world east of Colombia’s Andes. In this broader region, the savannas of the Orinoco basin give way towards the southeast to Amazon rainforest, a striking contrast with the densely settled Andean highlands.
simp_chinese: 瓜维亚雷属于哥伦比亚安第斯山脉以东的低地世界。在这一更广阔的地区，奥里诺科流域的稀树草原向东南方过渡为亚马孙雨林，与人口密集的安第斯高地形成鲜明对照。

english: Guaxaban belongs to the northern Mexican country of Aridoamerica. This wider ecological and cultural region contrasts with greener Mesoamerica to the south, with drought-resistant crops and seasonal water sources shaping life in its arid landscapes.
simp_chinese: 瓜沙班属于墨西哥北部的干旱美洲地区。这个广阔的生态文化区域与南方较葱郁的美索美洲形成对照，耐旱作物和季节性水源塑造着干旱景观中的生活。

english: Guaxenicos belongs to the wider Imabite and León country of Nicaragua. In the regional landscape, Momotombo rises above Lake Managua; the Spanish founded old León on the lake’s southwestern shore in 1524, but repeated seismic damage led its inhabitants to move the city after the earthquake of 1610.
simp_chinese: 瓜谢尼科斯属于尼加拉瓜广义的伊玛比特与莱昂地区。在地区景观中，莫莫通博火山高耸于马那瓜湖畔；西班牙人于1524年在湖西南岸建立老莱昂，反复的地震破坏使居民在1610年地震后迁城。

english: Guaxule belongs to the Cherokee country of the southern Appalachians. The wider region includes Kituwa, one of the seven mother towns, whose platform mound and communal townhouse held a sacred place in Cherokee memory.
simp_chinese: 瓜苏莱属于阿巴拉契亚南部切罗基地区。更广阔的区域包括七座母城之一基图瓦，其平台土丘与公共会堂在切罗基记忆中占有神圣地位。

english: The Guayabitos coast opens onto the Pacific along the western edge of the Mesoamerican region. Inland societies formed part of a long history of Indigenous agriculture and urban life that preceded Spanish colonization.
simp_chinese: 瓜亚比托斯海岸面向太平洋，位于中美洲文化区的西缘。沿岸腹地拥有悠久的原住民农业与城市生活传统，其历史早于西班牙殖民。

english: Guayacundo belongs to the highland Piura country of northwestern Peru. In the wider region, montane forests rise inland from dry coastal country. Cooler paramo environments appear higher in the sierra, creating a marked ecological contrast with the tropical desert below.
simp_chinese: 瓜亚昆多属于秘鲁西北皮乌拉高地地区。广义区域中，山地森林从干燥沿岸向内陆升起。更高山地出现凉爽帕拉莫环境，与下方热带荒漠形成显著生态差异。

english: Guayana is the broad region historically known as Spanish Guiana. In present-day Venezuela it encompasses Amazonas, Bolívar and Delta Amacuro, together covering slightly over half the country.
simp_chinese: 圭亚那是历史上称为西属圭亚那的广大地区。在今天的委内瑞拉，它包括亚马孙、玻利瓦尔和阿马库罗三角洲三州，合计面积略超过全国一半。

english: The Guayana Coast belongs to northeastern South America between the mouths of the Orinoco and Amazon. Before European colonisation, the broader Guianas were inhabited by Indigenous peoples including Lokono communities, linked to the river basins and Caribbean world.
simp_chinese: 圭亚那海岸属于南美洲东北部奥里诺科河口与亚马孙河口之间的地区。欧洲殖民以前，广阔的圭亚那地区已有洛科诺等原住民社会，与河流盆地及加勒比世界相联系。

english: The Guayana jungle covers part of the ancient Guiana Shield, a Precambrian foundation beneath northeastern South America. Its higher ground forms the Guiana Highlands, where flat-topped tepuis and great waterfalls rise above the surrounding forest country.
simp_chinese: 圭亚那丛林覆盖古老圭亚那地盾的一部分，这片前寒武纪基底位于南美洲东北部。较高地带形成圭亚那高地，平顶的特普伊山与壮观瀑布耸立于周围森林之上。

english: Guayangareo belongs to the broader Michoacán setting of western Mexico. The regional capital, now called Morelia, was formerly Valladolid and later received its name in honour of the independence leader José María Morelos.
simp_chinese: 瓜扬加雷奥属于墨西哥西部广义米却肯地区。地区首府今称莫雷利亚，旧名巴利亚多利德，后来为纪念独立领袖何塞·马里亚·莫雷洛斯而改名。

english: Guayaquil stands on the right bank of the Guayas, above the river's opening into its Pacific gulf. A pre-Hispanic name survived the establishment of Santiago de Guayaquil, linking the colonial port to the country that preceded it. Shipbuilding became a central occupation, and the harbour joined Spanish American commerce with Pacific routes reaching toward Manila and Callao. Its wealth also drew raiders. In October 1820 the city broke from Spanish rule and briefly headed its own Free Province before joining Gran Colombia, making the port a political as well as a commercial gateway.
simp_chinese: 瓜亚基尔坐落在瓜亚斯河右岸，河流由此通向太平洋同名海湾。前西班牙时代的地名在圣地亚哥德瓜亚基尔建立后仍然保留，将殖民港口与更早的地方历史相连。造船成为核心行业，港湾把西属美洲商业同通往马尼拉、卡亚俄的太平洋航路联结起来，财富也吸引了袭击者。1820年十月，城镇摆脱西班牙统治，短暂领导自己的自由省，随后加入大哥伦比亚，使港口同时成为政治与商业门户。

english: Guaycura recalls the people whose territory extended from near Loreto toward Todos Santos in southern Baja California. Their mobile hunter-gatherer bands spoke a language unrelated to neighbouring tongues. Eighteenth-century missions and introduced diseases brought severe population losses and ultimately dissolved their separate communities.
simp_chinese: 瓜伊库拉追忆着领地从洛雷托附近延向下加利福尼亚南部托多斯桑托斯的族群。流动的狩猎采集群体使用与邻近语言没有亲缘关系的语言。十八世纪传教站与传入疾病造成严重人口损失，最终使独立社群瓦解。

english: Guaygata belongs to the island country of Xaymaca, or Jamaica. In the wider island, Taíno communities practised agriculture and fishing, living in villages governed by caciques before European colonization.
simp_chinese: 瓜伊加塔属于夏伊马卡，即牙买加岛地区。在更广阔的岛屿上，欧洲殖民以前，泰诺社群从事农业和渔业，居住在酋长统治的村落。

english: On Puerto Rico's northeastern plain, Guaynabo contains the remains of Caparra, founded by Juan Ponce de León in 1508. The first Spanish governor lived in this early European settlement before it was abandoned in 1521 in favour of San Juan. The district later developed a different colonial landscape of farms and sugar estates. Guaynabo became a separate municipality in 1769, and Irish settlers Thomas O'Daly and Miguel Kirwan established the San Patricio plantation. These successive layers connect an abandoned first foothold with the agricultural society that spread behind the island's principal harbour.
simp_chinese: 瓜伊纳沃位于波多黎各东北平原，境内保存胡安·庞塞·德莱昂于1508年建立的卡帕拉遗址。首任西班牙总督曾居于这处早期欧洲聚落，1521年人们转向圣胡安，旧址遂被放弃。后来本区形成农场与糖业庄园构成的另一种殖民景观。瓜伊纳沃于1769年成为独立市镇，爱尔兰移民托马斯·奥戴利与米格尔·柯万建立圣帕特里西奥种植园。这些相继层次，将被遗弃的最初据点，与主要港口后方扩展的农业社会相连。

english: Guaynia extended along Puerto Rico's southern coast before European conquest. The Taíno ruler Agüeybaná governed the region around Guayanilla when Columbus reached the island in 1493.
simp_chinese: 瓜伊尼亚在欧洲征服前沿波多黎各南岸展开。1493年哥伦布抵达岛上时，泰诺首领阿圭瓦纳统治着瓜亚尼亚周边地区。

english: Guayupes recalls the Arawak-speaking Guayupe people of the eastern Colombian foothills. Their territory stretched from the Upía and Guayabero rivers to the Eastern Cordillera. Many communities lived around the Ariari, between Guahibo lands to the east and Muisca country to the west.
simp_chinese: 瓜尤佩斯因哥伦比亚东部山麓使用阿拉瓦克语的瓜尤佩人而得名。其地域从乌皮亚河、瓜亚贝罗河延伸到东科迪勒拉山脉。许多社群居于阿里亚里河周边，东邻瓜希博人，西接穆伊斯卡地区。

english: Guazacapán was already a settlement before the Spanish conquest of Guatemala. The country belonged to the Xinca world, with memories of earlier Pipil presence and a language distinct from the better-known neighbouring traditions. Local celebrations preserve costume, marimba music and dance, while efforts to teach the Guazacapán form of Xinca connect younger generations with that inheritance. Accounts of ritual specialists also survive in local memory, illustrating a cultural history that cannot be reduced to the municipality's later administrative boundaries.
simp_chinese: 瓜萨卡潘在西班牙征服危地马拉之前已经存在。当地属于辛卡人的世界，保留着更早皮皮尔人活动的记忆，其语言也有别于更为知名的邻近传统。地方庆典保存服饰、马林巴琴乐与舞蹈，教授瓜萨卡潘辛卡语的努力则将年轻世代与这份遗产联系起来。关于仪式专家的记述也留在地方记忆中，展现无法仅用后来行政边界概括的文化历史。

english: Guazapayogliglas belongs to the Guachichil country of northern Mexico. The wider Guachichil territories stretched across a large region from Zacatecas toward Saltillo, and their strategic position near Spanish mines and roads made resistance particularly effective.
simp_chinese: 瓜萨帕约格利格拉斯属于墨西哥北部的瓜奇奇尔地区。更广阔的瓜奇奇尔领地从萨卡特卡斯延向萨尔蒂约，靠近西班牙矿场与道路的战略位置使他们能够有效抵抗。

english: Guazhou belongs to the western Gansu corridor, where routes towards Dunhuang connected China with the lands beyond the Jade Gate. Guazhou and Shazhou once described wider and changing administrative regions before their names became more closely attached to separate centres. 'Guazhou' means the prefecture of melons, though historians have long disputed which ancient references apply to this district. Later Qing usage favoured the name Anxi, 'Tranquil West'. The succession of names reflects the difficulty of fitting a long-lived caravan landscape into the boundaries of any one dynasty.
simp_chinese: 瓜州属于甘肃西部走廊，通往敦煌的道路将中国与玉门关外的土地连接起来。瓜州与沙州曾指范围更大、不断变化的行政区域，后来才逐渐分别依附于不同中心。“瓜州”意为产瓜之州，但哪些古代记载对应本地，史家长期存在争论。清代后来更常使用“安西”之名。名称的更替反映出，将历史悠久的商旅景观纳入某一王朝固定边界，本就并不容易。

english: Guazoco belongs to the Tampa Bay country on Florida's Gulf coast. The later city of Tampa grew on the northern and eastern shores of the bay system, expanding rapidly after railways and cigar manufacturing arrived in the nineteenth century.
simp_chinese: 瓜索科属于佛罗里达墨西哥湾沿岸的坦帕湾地区。后来的坦帕城在海湾北岸和东岸发展，十九世纪铁路与雪茄制造业到来后迅速扩张。

english: Guba belongs to the wider Metekel country of western Ethiopia. The region borders Sudan, with the Abay and Dinder rivers marking parts of its boundaries and the Dangur range rising inland.
simp_chinese: 古巴位于埃塞俄比亚西部广义的梅特克尔地区。该地区同苏丹接壤，阿拜河与丁德尔河构成部分边界，内陆耸立丹古尔山脉。

english: The Kosva carries the waters of this Ural district towards the Kama, and it also carried the ores that gave Gubakha its first importance. The settlement arose in 1755 after iron ore was discovered on Krestovaya Mountain. At the meeting of the Gubashka and Kosva rivers, its wharf served barges moving ore from the upper river down towards the Kama. Coal was found on the same mountain in 1825, and the first adit opened there. Early output remained modest and was floated down the Kosva to smelting works; the great expansion of mining followed the railway's arrival in 1879. Gubakha's industrial city thus belongs to a later age, but its beginnings rested on a familiar combination of mineral wealth and river transport.
simp_chinese: 科斯瓦河把这片乌拉尔地区的河水带向卡马河，也曾运送使古巴哈初具重要性的矿石。1755年，克列斯托瓦亚山发现铁矿，聚落随之兴起。在古巴什卡河与科斯瓦河汇流处，当地码头为驳船服务，将上游矿石顺流运往卡马河。1825年，同一座山上又发现煤炭，并开凿了第一条平硐。早期产量仍然有限，煤炭经科斯瓦河漂运至冶炼厂；大规模采掘扩张则要等到1879年铁路到来之后。古巴哈的工业城市面貌因而属于较晚的时代，其起点却建立在矿藏与河运这一古老组合之上。

english: The Gubbi Gubbi, also called Kabi Kabi, are an Aboriginal people of southeastern Queensland. Their name derives from a word meaning “no,” a pattern shared by several regional ethnonyms.
simp_chinese: 古比古比人亦称卡比卡比人，是昆士兰东南部的原住民族。他们的族名源于表示“不”的词，周边若干族名也采用相似构词方式。

english: Gubbio occupies an upland basin beneath the limestone face of Monte Ingino, between the cultural worlds of Umbria, the Marches and Tuscany. Its ancient Iguvine tablets preserve the largest surviving body of text in the Umbrian language, while Roman Iguvium left a theatre and municipal traditions. The valley has an unusual drainage: streams run in opposite directions, yet both eventually reach the Tiber. A long-lived mint later served the Montefeltro and Della Rovere rulers as well as the papacy, giving this mountain town a monetary role beyond its immediate countryside.
simp_chinese: 古比奥占据因吉诺山石灰岩壁下的高地盆地，介于翁布里亚、马尔凯与托斯卡纳的文化世界之间。古代伊库维翁铜板保存着传世最丰富的翁布里亚语文本，罗马时代的伊古维翁则留下剧场与自治传统。谷地排水颇为特殊：溪流朝相反方向流去，最终却都汇入台伯河。长期运作的铸币所后来服务蒙特费尔特罗、德拉罗韦雷家族以及教廷，使山城拥有超越周边乡野的货币角色。

english: Guben grew beside the Lusatian Neisse between wooded plateaus and lakes. A trading settlement existed here by the eleventh century, and its riverside position encouraged economic growth. The surrounding land passed through Polish, Lusatian, Bohemian and Saxon political worlds, leaving a town whose history cannot be confined to a single later frontier. Even its heraldry recalls successive rulers. The twentieth-century division into Guben and Gubin came much later than the shared settlement, whose river had long served the movement of people and goods before becoming an international boundary.
simp_chinese: 古本在卢萨蒂亚尼斯河畔成长，周围是林木覆盖的台地与湖泊。十一世纪已有贸易聚落，河岸位置促进经济发展。周边先后进入波兰、卢萨蒂亚、波希米亚与萨克森政治世界，使城镇历史无法收束于某条较晚的国界之内，纹章也保存着历代统治者的记忆。二十世纪分为古本与古宾，远晚于共同聚落的形成；在成为国际边界之前，河流早已长期服务于人员和货物往来。

english: Gubio, also called Gobiyo, lies in the dry country of Bornu in northeastern Nigeria. It stands between Damasak to the north and Maiduguri to the south, roughly sixty miles from each, giving it a clear place along the route connecting those settlements. The town and its surrounding district form part of the traditional Borno Emirate. Rain falls chiefly from June to early September; during the long dry season, Harmattan winds carry dust and reduce both visibility and humidity. The rhythm of this Sahelian landscape is therefore set by a brief wet season and a much longer dry interval.
simp_chinese: 古比奥亦称戈比约，位于尼日利亚东北部博尔努的干旱地区。达马萨克在其北面，迈杜古里在其南面，两地距此均约六十英里，古比奥因而位于连接这两处聚落的道路上。城镇及周围地区属于传统的博尔努酋长国。降雨主要集中于六月至九月初；漫长旱季中，哈马丹风裹挟沙尘，使能见度与空气湿度一同下降。短促雨季与更长的干燥时段，构成了这片萨赫勒土地的季节节律。

english: Gucheng belongs to the Xiangyang region of northwestern Hubei. The broader regional centre occupies a strategic position on the Han River, with Xiangyang on the south bank and Fancheng on the north.
simp_chinese: 谷城属于湖北西北部的襄阳地区。更广阔地区的中心位于汉江战略要地，襄阳居南岸，樊城居北岸。

english: Gucheng lies in Hebei along the boundary with Dezhou in Shandong. Its climate brings cold, dry winters and wetter summers under the influence of the East Asian monsoon.
simp_chinese: 故城位于河北，与山东德州相邻。当地冬季寒冷干燥，夏季则受到东亚季风影响而较为湿润。

english: Gucheng belongs to the wider Guangzhou country of southeastern Henan. The imperial prefecture centred on modern Huangchuan and reached into the borderlands of Henan, Anhui and Hubei.
simp_chinese: 固城属于河南东南部更广阔的光州地区。古代光州以今潢川为中心，延伸至河南、安徽与湖北的交界地带。

english: Gucheng belongs to the Zhending country of northern China. The wider regional centre became important to Chinese Buddhism for more than a thousand years, retaining the Longxing Monastery and several pagodas of distinct styles.
simp_chinese: 鼓城属于中国北方的真定地区。更广阔区域的中心在一千多年间成为中国佛教重地，保存着隆兴寺和数座风格各异的佛塔。

english: Guchung belongs to the wider Beshbalik country of Dzungaria. The Old Turkic name Beshbalik means five cities, recalling a settlement cluster described in Chinese accounts of the former Jushi royal court.
simp_chinese: 古城属于准噶尔更广阔的别失八里地区。古突厥语Beshbalik意为五城，与中国史籍记载的原车师王庭聚落群相联系。

english: Guchuntikka belongs to the Grand Teton country of northwestern Wyoming. The wider mountain landscape drains to the Snake River, and successive glaciations carved the Teton peaks into their present forms.
simp_chinese: 古春提卡属于怀俄明西北部的大蒂顿地区。更广山地景观汇水至蛇河，多次冰川作用塑造了蒂顿诸峰今日的形态。

english: Gudamalani occupies an unusually green stretch of Thar country beside the Luni. Its position on the route between Jodhpur and Ahmedabad linked desert settlements with markets farther south. Local rulers bore the title Rana and maintained traditions of descent from the Vaghela line. Temples to Aalam Ji and other figures formed part of the district's religious landscape. River-fed fertility and a web of local lordship distinguish the place from a simple image of uninterrupted desert, while annual homage preserved relationships between villages and ruling families.
simp_chinese: 古达马拉尼位于鲁尼河旁、塔尔地区难得较绿的一段土地。焦特布尔至艾哈迈达巴德路线经过，将沙漠聚落与南方市场相连。当地统治者称拉纳，并保存瓦盖拉支系血统传统。阿拉姆吉等庙宇构成地区宗教地景。河水滋养的肥地和地方领主网络，使这里有别于连绵荒漠印象；年度致敬又维系村庄与统治家族的关系。

english: Gudur lies in the Nellore country of coastal Andhra, about forty-five kilometres from Nellore itself. The tropical seasons bring a pronounced contrast between wet and dry months, and the surrounding agricultural villages are especially associated with lemon cultivation. In later commercial life the town became a large lemon market, gathering fruit for sale across India and abroad. Beneath the surrounding country lie important mica-bearing formations, which also contain quartz, feldspar and other minerals; mining and mica trading became another distinctive part of Gudur's economy. These later industries should be distinguished from the older landscape represented here. The municipality was established only in 1954, and the modern railway junction joined the coastal main line to the route toward Renigunta. Fields, mineral ground and the meeting of inland and coastal connections give the locality its particular character.
simp_chinese: 古杜尔位于安得拉沿海的内洛尔地区，距内洛尔城约四十五公里。热带季节使雨季与旱季分明，周围农业村落尤其以种植柠檬著称。在后来的商业生活中，城镇发展为大型柠檬市场，汇集果实销往印度各地及海外。周边地下还分布重要的含云母地层，并伴有石英、长石等矿物；采矿与云母贸易也成为古杜尔经济的鲜明部分。这些后来的产业须与本地区更早的地理景观区分开来。古杜尔直到1954年才设立市政机构，现代铁路枢纽则将沿海干线与通往雷尼贡塔的线路相接。农田、矿藏以及内陆和沿海交通联系的交会，共同构成此地的特点。

english: Gueiquesales belongs to the Chisos country of the Big Bend. The wider mountain range rises from volcanic formations created tens of millions of years ago, with Emory Peak reaching roughly 2,385 metres above the surrounding drylands.
simp_chinese: 格基萨莱斯属于大弯地区奇索斯地带。更广阔的山脉建立于数千万年前形成的火山地层，埃默里峰海拔约2385米，耸立于周边旱地。

english: Guélengdeng lies in southern Chad's Mayo-Kebbi country. The town serves as the administrative centre of Mayo Lemie, connecting it with the surrounding district's settlements.
simp_chinese: 盖伦登位于乍得南部的东凯比地区。城镇是马约莱米的行政中心，与周围辖区内的聚落相联系。

english: Guelma occupies the site of ancient Calama within the fertile Seybouse country, where routes from the northeastern Algerian coast meet the interior. Roman buildings and the theater preserve the scale of an earlier town in Numidia. Its Christian community included the fifth-century bishop Possidius, while Byzantine defenses later enclosed the settlement. The subsequent history was uneven, and the old urban site lost much of its former prominence. French military occupation in 1836 began the establishment of another town around the ruins, initially using the older walls. Calama's remains therefore became part of a new colonial settlement, setting ancient civic stonework beside a changing frontier between coast and inland Algeria.
simp_chinese: 盖勒马占据古卡拉马遗址，位于肥沃的赛布斯地区，是阿尔及利亚东北海岸道路与内陆相接之处。罗马建筑和剧场保留着努米底亚旧城的规模。基督徒社群包括五世纪主教波西狄乌斯，后来的拜占庭防御又围护聚落。此后历史并非连续兴盛，旧城失去昔日大部分地位。1836年法国军队占领，开启围绕遗址建立新镇的过程，起初还利用旧墙。因此，卡拉马遗存成为新殖民聚落的一部分，使古代公共石构置于海岸与阿尔及利亚内陆之间不断变化的边疆。

english: Gueme Sangan belongs to Fouta Djallon, the highlands of Guinea. The Jallonke were among the region’s earliest inhabitants, and it formed part of the Sosso and Mali empires; from the seventeenth century it became an important stronghold of Islam.
simp_chinese: 盖梅桑甘属于几内亚富塔贾隆高地。贾隆克人是当地最早居民之一，这片区域曾属于索索与马里帝国，自十七世纪起又成为伊斯兰教的重要据点。

english: The Guenoa belonged to the Indigenous nations of Uruguay, Entre Ríos and neighbouring Brazil. They were related to the Charrúa and other regional peoples, and are often identified with the Minuan.
simp_chinese: 格诺阿人属于乌拉圭、恩特雷里奥斯及邻近巴西地区的原住民族群。他们与查鲁亚人等地方族群有联系，通常也被视为米努安人。

english: Guentota belongs to the Mendoza country of Cuyo beside the Andes. Evidence of human occupation in the wider region reaches back some twelve to thirteen thousand years, with later communities combining hunting and cultivation.
simp_chinese: 古恩托塔属于安第斯山旁库约的门多萨地区。周边地区的人类活动证据可追溯至约一万二千至一万三千年前，后来的社群将狩猎与耕作结合。

english: Guérande overlooks the contrasting 'White Land' of salt marshes and 'Black Land' of the Brière peat country. Sea, rivers and wetlands surround its peninsula, linking it to the Loire and Vilaine as well as Atlantic routes. Salt production made the district renowned, including the delicate crystals gathered as fleur de sel. Strong medieval walls enclosed the town above this worked landscape. The surviving circuit expresses the wealth and need for protection of a place where shallow coastal water could become a valuable cargo.
simp_chinese: 盖朗德俯临盐沼的“白地”与布里耶尔泥炭地区的“黑地”。海洋、河流和湿地包围半岛，将它与卢瓦尔河、维莱讷河以及大西洋航线相连。盐业使地区闻名，其中包括作为盐之花采集的细致晶体。坚固中世纪城墙围住这片经营景观上方的城镇。留存墙垣体现了当地财富与防卫需要；浅浅海水，在这里能够变成贵重货物。

english: Guercif lies in eastern Morocco, between Taza to the west and Taourirt to the east. Its countryside is particularly associated with olive cultivation, while the town serves as a meeting place for the produce of the surrounding land. A weekly Tuesday market brings together vegetables, fruit and livestock, alongside a smaller permanent market. Leatherworking, pottery, carpets and the equipment of horse and rider also belong to its craft economy. The olive harvest gives the locality a distinctive seasonal rhythm, celebrated in a festival devoted to the crop.
simp_chinese: 盖尔西夫位于摩洛哥东部，西接塔扎，东邻陶里尔特。周围乡野尤以橄榄种植著称，城镇则汇集附近土地的物产。每周二的集市交易蔬菜、水果与牲畜，另有一处持续营业的小市场。皮革加工、制陶、地毯，以及马匹与骑手所用装备，也构成当地手工业的一部分。橄榄收获赋予此地鲜明的季节节奏，人们还以专门的节庆庆祝这种作物。

english: Guéréda lies in the uplands of eastern Chad, in Dar Tama within the region now called Wadi Fira. Tama people form a majority of the town's modern population, alongside residents drawn from the surrounding country. Its documented conflicts belong to a much later era than the early modern kingdoms of this region. In December 2006, fighting between the Chadian army and rebel forces reached Guéréda, and control of the streets changed hands. Nearby Mile and Kounoungo have also sheltered refugees displaced by the Darfur conflict across the Sudanese frontier.
simp_chinese: 盖雷达位于乍得东部高地，属于达尔塔马，今日行政上隶属瓦迪菲拉地区。塔马人占现代城镇人口的多数，另有来自周边乡野的居民。这里有记载的冲突远晚于这一地区的近代早期诸王国。2006年12月，乍得政府军与叛军的战斗波及盖雷达，街区控制权随之易手。附近的米莱与库农戈也设有难民营，收容因苏丹边境另一侧达尔富尔冲突而流离失所的人群。

english: Guéret grew around a seventh-century abbey in the wooded country of La Marche. Its later role as the county's capital did not mean that the counts themselves lived in the town, a distinction obscured by the popular name given to the Hôtel de Moneyroux. Churches and administrative buildings instead show the gradual accumulation of ecclesiastical and civic functions. The seventeenth-century presidial and later Sénatorerie express successive systems of government; the latter also became home to a learned society in 1832. Nearby woodland and granite outcrops supplied another part of the setting. A modest provincial center thus joined monastic origins, offices and antiquarian learning without ever requiring a resident princely court.
simp_chinese: 盖雷围绕拉马什林地中的七世纪修道院成长。后来成为伯爵领首府，并不意味着伯爵本人住在城中，穆内鲁宅邸的通俗名称却容易模糊这一区别。教堂与行政建筑所显示的，是教会和城市职能逐渐积累。十七世纪高等地方司法机构及后来的元老官邸，表达接续的治理体系；后者又在1832年成为学术社团驻所。附近森林和花岗岩露头，构成环境的另一部分。这个规模不大的行省中心，由此结合修道院起源、官署与古物研究，却并不需要一座常驻诸侯宫廷。

english: Guettara is a town and commune in Algeria’s Djelfa region. Its population was recorded at just over eleven thousand in the 1998 census.
simp_chinese: 盖塔拉是阿尔及利亚杰勒法地区的一座城镇及同名市镇。1998年人口普查记录当地居民略多于一万一千人。

english: Gogera lies northwest of Okara in the Punjab. It served as the regional administrative seat during the rebellion of 1857, before that role moved to Montgomery, now Sahiwal.
simp_chinese: 戈杰拉位于旁遮普奥卡拉西北。1857年起义期间，它是地区行政驻地，后来这一职能转移到蒙哥马利，即今日的萨希瓦尔。

english: Gugu Badhun country lies in the upper Burdekin region of northern Queensland. Its traditional territory stands east of the Great Dividing Range around the Valley of Lagoons and neighboring river systems.
simp_chinese: 古古巴敦人的故土位于昆士兰北部伯德金河上游地区。传统领地处在大分水岭以东，环绕潟湖谷及邻近河流体系。

english: Guguan rises among the Northern Mariana Islands in the Pacific. The uninhabited island lies south of Alamagan and northeast of Sarigan, and was charted as San Felipe by the Spanish missionary Diego Luis de Sanvitores in 1668.
simp_chinese: 古关岛位于太平洋北马里亚纳群岛之中。这座无人岛处于阿拉马甘以南、萨里甘东北，西班牙传教士迭戈·路易斯·德·圣维托雷斯于1668年将其记为圣费利佩岛。

english: Guhlkahéndé belongs to the wider Aridoamerican country of northern Mexico and southwestern North America. Sparse rainfall feeds seasonal streams and waterholes, shaping distinctive regional cultures and ways of subsistence.
simp_chinese: 古尔卡亨德属于墨西哥北部与北美西南更广阔的干旱美洲地区。稀少降水补给季节性溪流与水穴，塑造了独特的地区文化和生计方式。

english: This forest country is associated with speakers of Guhu-Samane in New Guinea. Their language shows marked differences between inland and coastal varieties, as well as historical contact with neighboring Oceanic languages.
simp_chinese: 这片森林地域与新几内亚的古胡萨马内语使用者相关。他们的语言在内陆与沿海变体之间呈现明显差异，也反映了与邻近大洋洲语言的历史接触。

english: Gui belongs to the Kalahari country near the wider Xoo-speaking world. The neighboring Taa language, also called Xoo, is notable for its exceptionally rich sound system and prominent click consonants. Its speakers live mainly in Botswana, with smaller communities in Namibia.
simp_chinese: 圭属于卡拉哈里地区，靠近更广阔的库语世界。邻近的塔语又称库语，以格外丰富的语音系统和突出使用的吸气辅音闻名。使用者主要生活在博茨瓦纳，纳米比亚也有较小社群。

english: Guiaquitas belongs to the wider Guachichil country of Mexico. The Guachichil occupied extensive territories and used their position near mining and transport routes to resist Spanish settlement.
simp_chinese: 吉亚基塔斯属于墨西哥更广阔的瓜奇奇尔人地域。瓜奇奇尔人占据广大的土地，并利用靠近矿区和交通线路的位置抵抗西班牙人的扩张。

english: The Bungandidj people knew the country around Guichen Bay before French surveyors arrived in 1802. Baudin and Péron charted the inlet during their Australian expedition; Baudin called it the Bay of Albatrosses, but the published account adopted a name honouring the naval commander Guichen. European whalers, sealers and sailors later visited before formal settlement developed at Robe. The changing name records one encounter with the coast, while the older Indigenous presence reaches behind the charts. A bay that appeared as a new outline on European paper was already part of an inhabited country.
simp_chinese: 1802年法国测绘者抵达之前，邦甘迪杰人已熟知吉尚湾周边土地。博丹与佩龙在澳大利亚远征期间测绘海湾，博丹称其为信天翁湾，出版记述却采用纪念海军将领吉尚的名字。欧洲捕鲸者、海豹猎人和水手后来到访，此后才在罗布形成正式聚落。变化的名称记录一次海岸相遇，更古老的原住民活动则存在于海图之前。对欧洲纸面而言的新海湾轮廓，早已属于有人居住的土地。

english: Guichi forms the seat of Chizhou’s city government in Anhui. It was known as Guichi City before becoming a district in 2000.
simp_chinese: 贵池是安徽池州市政府驻地。这里在2000年设区之前称为贵池市。

english: The Guichita belonged to the wider Wichita world of the central and southern plains. River-terrace villages combined maize, beans and squash with hunting, fishing and gathering. Grass-covered houses provided a settled home for much of the year; winter bison hunts required more mobile camps. Bison supplied food, leather, sinew and shelter materials. The spread of horses in the seventeenth century enlarged the scale of hunting, but did not erase the agricultural foundations that distinguished Wichita communities from a wholly nomadic image of plains life.
simp_chinese: 吉奇塔属于中南部大平原更广的威奇托世界。河阶村落将玉米、豆类和南瓜种植，与狩猎、捕鱼及采集结合。覆草房屋在一年大部分时间提供固定家园，冬季猎野牛则需流动营地。野牛供应食物、皮革、筋腱与住处材料。十七世纪马匹传播扩大了狩猎规模，却未消除农业基础；这使威奇托社群有别于完全游牧的平原生活印象。

english: Guide, known in Tibetan as Trika, occupies a Yellow River valley in eastern Qinghai. First established under the Yuan, its old town gained earthen walls and buildings in the later fourteenth century, amid hills and a relatively mild fruit-growing environment.
simp_chinese: 贵德藏语称赤噶，位于青海东部的黄河谷地。当地建置始于元代，旧城土墙与建筑形成于十四世纪后期，周围山丘环绕，较温和的环境适合果树生长。

english: Guidimouni is a town in southern Niger. It lies near Zinder within the southern settlement belt of the country.
simp_chinese: 吉迪穆尼是尼日尔南部的一座城镇。它靠近津德尔，属于该国南部的聚居地带。

english: Guidong lies on Hunan’s southeastern margin beside Jiangxi. It forms the easternmost part of the Chenzhou region, with the county seat at Oujiang.
simp_chinese: 桂东位于湖南东南边缘，毗邻江西。它构成郴州地区最东部，县治设在沤江。

english: Guihua belongs to southern Sichuan, between the basin country and the uplands toward Yunnan and Guizhou. The wider province was home to the ancient Ba and Shu kingdoms before Qin conquest around 316 BCE. Later Sichuan again formed the core of Liu Bei’s Shu state.
simp_chinese: 归化属于川南，处于盆地域与通向云贵的高地之间。广大四川地区曾为古代巴、蜀王国所在，约公元前316年被秦征服。后来四川再次成为刘备蜀国的核心。

english: Guiigu yudxi belongs to the Tehuantepec country of Oaxaca. The wider region lay on a pre-Hispanic trade route between Central America and central Mexico and became an important centre of Zapotec power.
simp_chinese: 维维尤吉属于瓦哈卡的特万特佩克地区。更广区域位于西班牙征服前连接中美洲与墨西哥中部的商路上，并成为萨波特克势力的重要中心。

english: Guildford grew beside a crossing of the Wey, beneath the hills of Surrey. Its Anglo-Saxon importance included a royal mint, while Norman conquest brought a castle later developed into Henry III’s residence. Wool enriched the late medieval town, and Henry VII granted incorporation in 1488. The opening of the Wey Navigation in 1653 widened its commercial reach, allowing produce, building materials and manufactured goods to travel toward London by water. A ford, a castle and an improved river together explain how this inland town became closely tied to the capital’s growing markets.
simp_chinese: 吉尔福德在韦伊河渡口旁、萨里丘陵下成长。盎格鲁—撒克逊时代的重要性包括王室铸币厂，诺曼征服后又有城堡，后来发展为亨利三世驻所。羊毛使中世纪晚期城镇富裕，亨利七世于1488年授予市镇法人地位。1653年韦伊河航道开放，扩大商业联系，使农产、建材与制成品能循水路运往伦敦。渡口、城堡与改善后的河流，共同解释这座内陆城镇如何紧密联入首都增长的市场。

english: Guiling belongs to the Hezhou country of northeastern Guangxi, near the meeting of Hunan and Guangdong. The wider hilly region has a humid subtropical monsoon climate, with damp mild winters and hot rainy summers.
simp_chinese: 桂岭属于广西东北贺州地区，靠近湖南与广东交接处。更广阔的丘陵地区为湿润亚热带季风气候，冬季温和潮湿，夏季炎热多雨。

english: Guimarães grew from two linked centres: Mumadona Dias's tenth-century monastery below and her protective castle above. Rua de Santa Maria connected the settlements. Its association with Afonso Henriques and the nearby Battle of São Mamede made it central to Portugal's foundation story. Medieval life also included a Jewish community with schools, synagogue and market. The conversion-or-expulsion decree of 1496 disrupted that public life. The surviving town therefore carries both royal memory and the traces of communities whose institutions once shared its streets.
simp_chinese: 吉马良斯由上下两个中心成长：十世纪穆马多娜·迪亚斯在低处建立修道院，又在高处筑堡保护。圣玛丽亚街连接两处聚落。它与阿方索·恩里克斯及附近圣马梅德战役的联系，使其成为葡萄牙建国记忆的核心。中世纪生活也包括拥有学校、会堂与市场的犹太社群。1496年改宗或离境法令破坏了这种公共生活。保存的城镇因而既有王室记忆，也有曾共享街道的社群痕迹。

english: The Bight of Benin forms part of the great inward curve of the Gulf of Guinea, where the tropical Atlantic meets the shores of West Africa. The Volta and Niger belong to the river systems pouring into the wider gulf, linking inland drainage with coastal waters. 'Guinea' itself has carried shifting meanings, once distinguishing broad upper and lower coastal regions rather than a single state. Offshore volcanic islands belong to a different chain of landmarks. The gulf thus gathers river mouths, open sea and several regional worlds beneath a geographical name older than modern borders.
simp_chinese: 贝宁湾属于几内亚湾巨大的内弯，热带大西洋在此接触西非海岸。沃尔特河与尼日尔河属于注入更大海湾的河系，将内陆水流与沿海水域连接起来。“几内亚”的含义本就不断变化，过去曾区别广阔的上、下沿海区域。外海火山岛又构成另一列地标。河口、外海与数个地方世界，由此汇集于一个早于现代国界的地理名称之下。

english: Guinea’s forests belong to the Atlantic-facing landscapes of West Africa. The country borders Sierra Leone and Liberia to the south and Ivory Coast to the southeast.
simp_chinese: 几内亚的森林属于西非面向大西洋的景观。该国南邻塞拉利昂与利比里亚，东南与科特迪瓦接壤。

english: Guiping stands at the meeting of the Qian and Yu rivers in eastern Guangxi. Formerly known as Xunzhou, it served as the capital of the Da Cheng rebel state from 1855 to 1861.
simp_chinese: 桂平位于广西东部的黔江与郁江交汇处。这里旧称浔州，1855至1861年间曾是大成起义政权的都城。

english: In eastern Mato Grosso, the country now called Guiratinga was home to Bororo communities long before the mining settlement appeared. The modern town belongs to a much later chapter: diamond working drew migrants into the region in the early twentieth century, and Augusto Alves laid out a settlement beside local streams in the 1920s. Miners came from Goiás, Minas Gerais and Bahia, turning river gravel into the foundation of a growing town. Known first as Lageado, it became a municipal seat in 1933 and acquired the name Guiratinga in 1943. The new name draws on Tupi words associated with a white bird or heron, recalling an older landscape beneath the mining frontier.
simp_chinese: 马托格罗索东部今天称作吉拉廷加的地方，在矿业聚落出现之前，早已有博罗罗人社区生活。现代城镇属于晚得多的一段历史：二十世纪初，钻石开采吸引移民进入这一地区，奥古斯托·阿尔维斯于1920年代在当地溪流旁规划聚落。来自戈亚斯、米纳斯吉拉斯和巴伊亚的矿工，以河床砂砾中的财富奠定了城镇发展的基础。聚落最初名为拉热阿多，1933年成为市镇治所，1943年改称吉拉廷加。新名称源自与白鸟或白鹭有关的图皮语词，保留着矿业边疆之下更古老的自然印记。

english: Guiré lies southeast of Nara in the Sahelian lands of Mali. The small town gives its name to a broad rural commune extending to the Mauritanian frontier, an expanse of roughly 6,892 square kilometres. In its modern administrative form this territory includes twenty-five villages, illustrating how widely dispersed settlement is around the central town. Nara, about ninety kilometres to the northwest, serves as the surrounding district's administrative centre.
simp_chinese: 吉尔位于纳拉东南方、马里的萨赫勒地带。这座小镇为一个辽阔的乡村市镇命名，其范围一直延伸到毛里塔尼亚边界，面积约6,892平方公里。按照现代行政范围，这片土地包括25座村庄，显出中心城镇周围聚落的分散格局。纳拉位于西北约90公里处，是周围行政区的中心。

english: The medieval castle at Guise recalls the town's place among the aristocratic seats of northern France. Its name became that of the dukes of Guise, later princes of Joinville, and the surviving fortress remains the clearest monument to that association. Set in Thiérache, Guise also serves an agricultural hinterland in the north of the Aisne. The town produced Camille Desmoulins, born in 1760, whose journalism and politics carried him into the turmoil of the French Revolution. A different vision of society took visible form here after the early modern era: beginning around 1856, the industrialist Jean-Baptiste Godin built the Familistère, combining industry, communal housing, and services inspired by Fourier's ideas.
simp_chinese: 吉斯的中世纪城堡见证了这座城镇作为法国北部贵族领地中心的地位。它的名字成为吉斯公爵家族的称号，后者又获封茹安维尔亲王；留存的堡垒是这一联系最鲜明的遗迹。吉斯位于蒂耶拉什，也服务于埃纳北部的农业腹地。卡米耶·德穆兰于1760年出生在此，他的新闻写作与政治活动使他卷入法国大革命的激流。近代早期结束之后，另一种社会理想在这里化为实物：约从1856年起，实业家让-巴蒂斯特·戈丹修建了法米利斯泰尔，将工厂、集体住宅与公共服务相结合，其构想受到傅立叶思想的影响。

english: Guishan belongs to the Huizhou country of Guangdong. The wider regional centre was a prefectural capital and cultural centre during the Song dynasty, later associated with the exile of the poet Su Shi and the landscape of West Lake.
simp_chinese: 归善属于广东惠州地区。更广阔区域的中心在宋代是州治和文化中心，后来与诗人苏轼的贬谪及西湖景观相联系。

english: Guishun belongs to the Jingxi country of western Guangxi. Zhuang communities form the overwhelming majority of the wider district’s population. Its varied Zhuang dialects reflect several centuries of migration from other parts of Guangxi and from neighbouring Vietnam.
simp_chinese: 归顺属于广西西部靖西地区。壮族社群构成更广阔地区人口的绝大多数。多样的壮语方言反映了数百年来来自广西其他地区及邻近越南的迁徙。

english: Guixi lies in Jiangxi beside the Fujian border. Its central settlement of Xiongshi stands on the Xin River.
simp_chinese: 贵溪位于江西，毗邻福建边界。其中心聚落雄石坐落于信江沿岸。

english: Guixin belongs to the Rongcheng country of central Hebei. The wider county lies within Baoding’s administrative region and has its seat at Rongcheng town. Settlements including Xiaoli, Nanzhang and Dahe share this compact part of the northern Chinese plain.
simp_chinese: 归信属于河北中部的容城地区。更广阔的县域隶属保定，治所在容城镇。小里、南张、大河等聚落共同分布在这片紧凑的华北平原地区。

english: Guiyang lies in southern Hunan within the Chenzhou region. Changning and Leiyang border it to the north, while Xintian and Jiahe lie to the west.
simp_chinese: 桂阳位于湖南南部的郴州地区。其北邻常宁和耒阳，西接新田与嘉禾。

english: Guiyang lies in southern Hunan within the Chenzhou region. Its surrounding county borders Changning and Leiyang to the north and Linwu to the south.
simp_chinese: 桂阳位于湖南南部的郴州地区。周围县域北邻常宁、耒阳，南接临武。

english: Guizhou is an inland region of southwestern China with a humid subtropical climate. It became a formal province under the Ming in 1413, and Guiyang developed as its principal administrative centre.
simp_chinese: 贵州是中国西南部的内陆地区，气候湿润，属亚热带。明代1413年正式建省，贵阳逐渐成为主要行政中心。

english: Guizhou belongs to the Xunzhou country around modern Guiping in eastern Guangxi. The wider river junction brings together the Qian and Yu rivers, the principal northern and southern tributaries of the Xi River.
simp_chinese: 桂州属于广西东部今桂平周边的浔州地区。更广阔的河流交汇地带汇合黔江与郁江，两者分别是西江的主要北、南支流。

english: Gujō lies in the Mino country near the headwaters of the Nagara. At Hachiman, the Yoshida, Nagara and Kodara rivers meet, and an intricate system of channels and fountains has served households since the seventeenth century. Rules distinguish what can be washed in each place, helping preserve clean water for neighbours. Under the Tokugawa it formed part of Gujō Domain. The enduring waterways reveal the everyday organisation of a castle-domain community as clearly as political boundaries do.
simp_chinese: 郡上位于美浓地区、长良川源头附近。八幡一带，吉田川、长良川与小驮良川交会，精细的水渠和泉口系统自十七世纪以来便服务居民。规则区分各处可以清洗什么，帮助为邻人保留清洁水源。德川时期，这里属于郡上藩。延续的水道与政治边界一样，清楚展现了藩领社群的日常组织方式。

english: Gujrat lies in the Jech or Chaj Doab of Punjab, between the Jhelum and Chenab rivers. The region’s name combines elements of those two river names, and its upper country rises towards the southern fringes of Kashmir.
simp_chinese: 古杰拉特位于旁遮普杰赫、又称查杰河间地，处在杰赫勒姆河与杰纳布河之间。地区名称结合了两条河流名称的成分，上游地势朝克什米尔南缘升高。

english: Gulang lies at the eastern end of the Hexi Corridor, south of the Tengger Desert in Gansu. Its dry, cold climate produces far more evaporation than rainfall, while archaeological evidence records settlement in the area around four thousand years ago.
simp_chinese: 古浪位于甘肃河西走廊东端、腾格里沙漠以南。干冷气候下蒸发量远超降雨量，考古证据则记录了约四千年前当地已有居民。

english: Gulbarga became the first capital of the Bahmani Sultanate after Ala-ud-Din Bahman Shah's revolt against Delhi in 1347. Its fort, great mosque and domed tombs preserve the architecture of this new Deccan court. The surrounding plateau, watered by the Krishna and Bhima systems and numerous tanks, supported cultivation on dark soils. Later the region passed among the successor sultanates, the Mughals and Hyderabad. The city's history therefore joins a distinctive royal and religious landscape to the agricultural country that sustained power on the northern Deccan.
simp_chinese: 古尔伯加在阿拉丁·巴赫曼沙于1347年反抗德里后，成为巴赫曼尼苏丹国的第一座首都。堡垒、大清真寺与穹顶陵墓保存着这个德干新宫廷的建筑。周围高原由克里希纳河、毗摩河水系和众多水池滋养，黑土地支撑耕作。地区后来转入继承苏丹国、莫卧儿与海得拉巴统治。城市历史由此将独特的王权和宗教景观，同维系北德干势力的农业乡野联系起来。

english: Gulbene's medieval history begins amid the division of Livonian lands recorded in 1224 between the Sword Brothers and Riga's archbishop. In the fourteenth century the archbishop built a stone castle here, and settlement gathered around it. The ground had an older significance as a Latgalian fortified mound. Later structures replaced parts of this layered stronghold, but the sequence remains revealing: an Indigenous defensive site became an ecclesiastical fortress and then the focus of an estate landscape. Gulbene's importance long preceded the railways that eventually transformed it.
simp_chinese: 古尔贝内的中世纪历史，始于1224年记载的宝剑骑士团与里加大主教之间的利沃尼亚土地划分。十四世纪，大主教在此修建石堡，聚落围绕其成长。这片土地更早是拉特加尔人的设防土丘。后来的建筑替代了部分层叠要塞，但演变仍清晰可见：原住民防御地变为教会堡垒，继而成为庄园景观中心。古尔贝内的重要性，远早于最终改变它的铁路时代。

english: Gülchö occupies a broad mountain valley where three rivers meet to form the Kurshab. To its north, the Chyrchyk pass separates it from Osh; to the south, the higher Taldyk pass opens toward the Alay valley and Sary-Tash. The settlement therefore lies between two very different crossings rather than on an uninterrupted plain. Warm, dry summers alternate with freezing winters, and the highest routes demand movement suited to the season. Its significance comes from the meeting of watercourses and the narrow choices that mountain travel offers between neighboring valleys.
simp_chinese: 古尔乔位于三河汇成库尔沙布河的宽阔山谷。北方奇尔奇克山口将它与奥什分开，南方更高的塔尔德克山口则通向阿赖谷地和萨雷塔什。因此，聚落处于两个不同越岭通道之间，周边并非连续平原。温暖干燥的夏季与冰冷冬季交替，高处路线要求行旅顺应季节。地方意义来自水系交会，以及山地旅行在相邻河谷之间提供的有限选择。

english: Between Yemen and the Horn of Africa, the Gulf of Aden joins the Arabian Sea to the narrow entrance of the Red Sea at Bab el-Mandeb. Ancient Greek writers included it within their Erythraean Sea. Medieval geographical works and the navigator Ibn Majid also called it the Gulf of Berbera, testimony to the African port's commercial importance. Fishing along the shores supplemented the passage of larger trading vessels. The gulf connected two coasts whose ports participated in a much wider Indian Ocean world.
simp_chinese: 亚丁湾位于也门与非洲之角之间，将阿拉伯海同曼德海峡狭窄的红海入口相连。古希腊作者将它纳入厄立特里亚海的范围。中世纪地理著作和航海家伊本·马吉德又称其为柏培拉湾，见证非洲这座港口的商业重要性。沿岸渔业与较大商船的往来并存。海湾联结的两侧港口，都参与着远为广阔的印度洋世界。

english: Between southern Arabia and the Horn of Africa, the Gulf of Aden joins the Arabian Sea to the narrow entrance of the Red Sea. Ancient writers included it in the Erythraean Sea, while medieval geographers and the navigator Ibn Majid also called it the Gulf of Berbera. That name gives the African shore its proper place in a maritime world often named after Arabian Aden. Incense, tortoiseshell and other goods moved through its ports. Monsoon knowledge drew ships towards direct ocean crossings, making these waters a meeting place of coastal exchange and long-distance navigation.
simp_chinese: 阿拉伯南部与非洲之角之间，亚丁湾将阿拉伯海接入红海狭窄入口。古代作者把它纳入厄立特里亚海，中世纪地理学家和航海家伊本·马吉德也称其为柏培拉湾。这个名字表明，在常以阿拉伯亚丁命名的海洋世界中，非洲海岸同样具有地位。乳香、玳瑁及其他货物经过沿岸港口。季风知识引导船只直接横渡大洋，使这些水域成为沿海交换与远航技术的交会处。

english: The Gulf of Aden joins the Arabian Sea to the narrow entrance of the Red Sea, between Yemen and the Somali coast. Medieval writers also called it the Gulf of Berbera, preserving the importance of that African port. Incense, tortoiseshell and other goods moved through a maritime world reaching India and the Mediterranean. Monsoon knowledge altered the balance between sea routes and inland caravans. Across the gulf, trade and migration linked shores that a map might otherwise present as separate continents.
simp_chinese: 亚丁湾位于也门与索马里海岸之间，将阿拉伯海与红海狭窄入口连接。中世纪作者也称其为柏培拉湾，保存了非洲港口的重要性。乳香、玳瑁及其他货物在通达印度与地中海的海洋世界流动。季风知识改变海路与内陆商队之间的平衡。贸易与迁徙跨湾连接两岸，使地图上分属大陆的土地发生紧密往来。

english: The Gulf of Alexandretta forms the far eastern recess of the Mediterranean beside Cilicia and the Nur Mountains. Its successive names recall different centres of power: ancient Issus and Myriandus, medieval Armenian Cilicia, and the harbour of Alexandretta itself. The mountains were often treated as a division between Cilicia and Syria, placing the gulf at a meeting of geographical regions. Looking inland from these waters, the traveller encountered both a coastal plain and a mountain boundary, a setting that gave the bay enduring regional significance.
simp_chinese: 亚历山大勒塔湾构成地中海最东端的凹入，毗邻奇里乞亚与努尔山脉。历代称呼让人想起不同权力中心：古伊苏斯与米里安德鲁斯、中世纪亚美尼亚奇里乞亚，以及亚历山大勒塔港本身。群山常被视为奇里乞亚与叙利亚的分界，使海湾位于地理区域交会之处。从水面望向内陆，旅人面对沿海平原与山地边界并存的环境，这赋予湾区持久的区域意义。

english: At the northern end of the Red Sea, the Gulf of Aqaba draws maritime routes toward the dry country of Arabia and the Levant. Ancient Ayla stood near its head as a Nabataean commercial centre. Roman road building connected that harbour with the Via Traiana Nova and the King's Highway, joining inland caravans to seaborne exchange. The gulf's waters also sustain a distinctive marine community shaped by salinity and temperature. Its narrow shape brings desert margins and rich underwater habitats into close proximity.
simp_chinese: 红海北端的亚喀巴湾，将海路引向阿拉伯与黎凡特的干燥土地。古艾拉城位于湾顶附近，是纳巴泰人的商业中心。罗马道路将港口同新图拉真大道及国王大道相接，把内陆商队与海上交换联系起来。海湾水域也维系着受盐度和水温塑造的独特海洋生物群。狭长地形使沙漠边缘与丰富水下栖息地紧密相邻。

english: The Gulf of Asinara opens along northern Sardinia between Asinara Island, Cape Falcone and Castelsardo. Porto Torres and a succession of long beaches line the mainland side of the gulf.
simp_chinese: 阿西纳拉湾沿撒丁岛北部展开，处于阿西纳拉岛、法尔科内角与卡斯特尔萨尔多之间。托雷斯港及连续的长滩分布于海湾大陆一侧。

english: Bahrain’s waters belong to the Persian Gulf between Arabia and Iran. The Strait of Hormuz connects this reef-rich basin with the Gulf of Oman.
simp_chinese: 巴林水域属于阿拉伯半岛与伊朗之间的波斯湾。霍尔木兹海峡将这片礁体丰富的海盆与阿曼湾连通。

english: North Africa’s coast forms the southern margin of the western Mediterranean. At the basin’s western entrance, the Alboran Sea reaches the Atlantic through Gibraltar.
simp_chinese: 北非海岸构成西地中海南缘。在海盆西部入口，阿尔沃兰海经直布罗陀海峡通向大西洋。

english: The Gulf of Bomba opens on Libya’s Mediterranean coast east of Derna. In April 1805 supplies landed here sustained William Eaton’s overland force before its attack on Derna during the First Barbary War.
simp_chinese: 邦巴湾位于德尔纳以东的利比亚地中海岸。1805年4月在此卸下的补给支持了威廉·伊顿的陆路部队，使其随后在第一次巴巴里战争中进攻德尔纳。

english: The Gulf of Cagliari opens along southern Sardinia and is also known as the Gulf of Angels. Rocky promontories, sandy beaches and coastal wetlands frame its shores. Cagliari's port occupies the central part of the gulf, while the ancient site of Nora lies along the surrounding coast.
simp_chinese: 卡利亚里湾沿撒丁岛南岸展开，又称天使湾。岩岬、沙滩和沿海湿地围绕湾岸。卡利亚里港位于海湾中部，古代诺拉遗址则分布在周边海岸。

english: Between Capo Rama and Capo San Vito, a deep natural indentation opens from western Sicily toward the Tyrrhenian Sea. Romans called it Sinus Aegestanus, tying the gulf to Segesta inland. A later cartographic name, Longuro or Longarico, instead recalled an older center near Alcamo, showing how the same waters acquired names from different shoreside communities. Castellammare occupies the middle of the coastal arc, with fishing settlements and beaches spreading toward the headlands. At Scopello, sea stacks stand beside a tonnara, a reminder of the tuna fisheries associated with this coast. The gulf brought ancient cities, small harbors and specialized maritime labor into a shared stretch of water.
simp_chinese: 拉马角与圣维托角之间，西西里西部一道深广天然凹湾向第勒尼安海敞开。罗马人称其为埃盖斯塔努斯湾，将水域与内陆的塞杰斯塔相连。后来的地图名称隆古罗或隆加里科，则呼应阿尔卡莫附近更早的中心，显示同一片水域如何从不同岸边社群获得名字。卡斯特拉马雷位于海岸弧线中部，渔村与沙滩向岬角展开。斯科佩洛的海蚀柱旁有一座金枪鱼渔场，使人想起这一海岸的专业捕捞。海湾将古城、小港和专门的海上劳动联入同一片水域。

english: The Gulf of Catania opens into the Ionian Sea on Sicily’s eastern coast. Bounded by Cape Campolato and Cape Mulini, it receives the Simeto below Catania with Mount Etna rising nearby.
simp_chinese: 卡塔尼亚湾在西西里东海岸通向爱奥尼亚海。海湾介于坎波拉托角与穆利尼角之间，在卡塔尼亚以南承接西梅托河水，附近耸立着埃特纳火山。

english: The Gulf of Corinth separates the Peloponnese from central Greece, narrowing westward at Rion before reaching the Gulf of Patras. In medieval usage it was also the Gulf of Lepanto, taking a name from Naupactus. Its northern shores are generally gentler than the steep southern margin, and faults beneath the water keep the landscape seismically active. At the eastern end the isthmus closes the inlet; before the modern canal, this strip of land separated its waters from the Saronic side and shaped the choices of ships crossing the Greek world.
simp_chinese: 科林斯湾将伯罗奔尼撒同希腊中部分开，西端在里翁收窄，再接帕特雷湾。中世纪也称其为勒班陀湾，名称来自瑙帕克托斯。北岸总体较缓，南缘却陡，水下断层使景观保持地震活动。东端地峡封住海湾；现代运河出现以前，这道陆地将海湾同萨罗尼克一侧分隔，左右穿行希腊世界船只的道路选择。
